description: Codex via `ollama launch`, as a bare stateless engine node — `r4t engine ollama-codex run`, one headless turn per wake with no roster or dispatcher, local model, no cloud quota; STATUS.md/LESSONS.md hold working state; enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Requires a8s var MODEL (`a8s add ... --model=...` or `a8s vars <name> set MODEL ...`); tune it further with --permissions on the invoke lines below; `r4t engine ollama-codex check` proves the argv still parses. Turn timeout defaults to 900s; override per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
